text: There's an easel and a crayon over there. Maybe you could draw a sword?
Draw. A. Sword. On the easel, hero!
That box is hanging from a rope. Try your shiny new sword on it!
Swing your sword at the rope above the box!
Catch my fireball! Don't worry, it won't burn you.
Grab the fireball and hold it against the rope!
Bring the key up to me. Right here, to the picture!
Touch the key to the picture, hero!
If only we had a picture of the key. Is that a camera over there?
Pick up the camera and take a photo of the key!
Ooh, a photograph! Now bring it to me.
Put the photo into the picture, hero!
That's a little small for a sword. Bigger, hero!
Hmm. Is that a baguette?
I've seen scarier butter knives.
Even the witch draws better than that. Try again!
It's tied up, silly. Deal with the rope first!
Don't bother, that glass is sword-proof. The witch thought of everything.
Hammer-proof glass, hero. She really did think of everything.
My hand is right here. Touch the glowing handprint!
Put your hand or controller against the gold handprint on the painting!
